observed.insights:
01
Selected cohort

8,813 downloaded systematic sample requests were created from 2025-01-01 through 2025-03-31 (NYC local dates). Mean = 97.9 requests per covered day (90/90 days covered). The selected calendar is fully covered for this sample.

02
Movement inside this window

First 7 versus last 7 covered local calendar days: 918 arrivals (2025-01-01–2025-01-07) versus 627 (2025-03-25–2025-03-31), -31.7%. This describes sampled arrivals, not a causal effect, annual seasonality or citywide demand.

03
Agency mix

NYPD accounts for 3,891 requests (44.2%) in the selected cohort. This identifies where sampled arrivals concentrate; agencies handle different complaint mixes and request difficulty, so shares are not staff-performance rankings.

filtered_weather.interpretation:
What this relationship supports
The association is recalculated when your cohort changes

Filtered arrivals / weather · Spearman ρ

-0.416

28 paired days · Estimable · minimum 10 days and variation in both variables required.

The selected sample has a negative rank association (ρ=-0.416) with precipitation. Complaint mix, sampling and season may explain the relationship. This is exploratory evidence, not a weather effect or a forecast.
The available quarter-year history cannot establish annual seasonality. Weather comes from one NYC reference point and is used for retrospective analysis only.
